idea-plugin.name: CodeIME
idea-plugin.description:
CodeIME switches your input method automatically: Chinese inside comments and docstrings, English in code — no more manual Shift-toggling between writing comments and writing code.

根据光标上下文自动切换输入法：注释与 docstring 内自动切中文，代码内自动切英文，无需手动按 Shift。

  • Comments & Python docstrings → Chinese / 注释与 docstring → 中文
  • Code → English / 代码 → 英文
  • Works with all languages that have a PSI parser（支持所有可解析的语言）
  • No switching during selection drag or when the IDE is unfocused / 选中拖拽、IDE 失焦不误切
  • Configurable toggle hotkey with atomic keystroke injection / 中英切换热键可配置，原子注入防误触

Requirements: Windows 10/11 + Microsoft Pinyin（微软拼音）. IntelliJ Platform 2026.1+.

Source code: github.com/wsqiangyx/code-ime (GPL-3.0)
